title: [Exercise] Predict Political Parties of Politicians with Keras

cues.en: So let's try this out and play some more with Keras.
cues.zh: 來試試，繼續實驗 Keras。

cues.en: Make sure you are in the RecSys environment in Anaconda navigator.
cues.zh: 確認 Anaconda Navigator 選在 RecSys 環境。

cues.en: And we first need to add the Pandas package to our RecSys environment.
cues.zh: 首先，要把 pandas 套件加入 RecSys 環境。

cues.en: So select not installed.
cues.zh: 選 Not installed。

cues.en: Search for Pandas.
cues.zh: 搜尋 pandas。

cues.en: Select it and hit apply to kick off it's installation.
cues.zh: 勾選，再按 Apply 開始安裝。

cues.en: We also need to install the scikit_learn package so follow the same procedure to install that as well.
cues.zh: 也需要 scikit-learn 套件，照相同流程安裝。

cues.en: Scikit dash learn is what you're looking for.
cues.zh: 要找的是 scikit-learn，中間有連字號。

cues.en: Then open up your Jupyter notebook
cues.zh: 接著開啟 Jupyter Notebook，

cues.en: and upload the PoliticsExercise.ipynb file from your course materials DeepLearningIntro folder.
cues.zh: 上傳課程教材 DeepLearningIntro 資料夾中的 PoliticsExercise.ipynb。

cues.en: Once it's imported find it in the list
cues.zh: 匯入後，在清單找到它，

cues.en: and click on it to open it.
cues.zh: 點選開啟。

cues.en: The house votes data files we need are also included in the course materials.
cues.zh: 需要的眾議院投票資料檔，也包含在課程教材。

cues.en: This example is actually an exercise that I want you to try yourself.
cues.zh: 這個例子，其實是要你自行嘗試的練習。

cues.en: I'll help you load up this data and clean it up, but after that I will leave it up to you to actually implement a neural network with Keras to classify these things.
cues.zh: 我會協助載入、清理資料，之後就交給你，用 Keras 實作神經網路來分類。

cues.en: So to recap, we will load up some data about a bunch of congressional votes that various politicians made.
cues.zh: 回顧一下，載入各位政治人物的國會投票資料。

cues.en: And we're going to try to see if we can predict if a politician is Republican or Democrat just based on how they voted on 17 different issues.
cues.zh: 只根據他們在 17 個議題的投票，看看能否預測是共和黨還是民主黨。

cues.en: This is older data from 1984 so you definitely need to be of a certain age to remember what these issues were.
cues.zh: 這是 1984 年的舊資料，要到一定年紀，才會記得這些議題。

cues.en: If you're from outside of the United States, just to give you a brief primer in US politics, there are two main political parties in the United States: the Republicans which tend to be more conservative,
cues.zh: 如果你不是美國人，簡單介紹美國政治：美國有兩個主要政黨，共和黨通常比較保守，

cues.en: and the Democrats which tend to be more progressive.
cues.zh: 民主黨通常比較進步。

cues.en: Their stances have changed over the years, but that's the current deal.
cues.zh: 多年來立場有變，但目前大致如此。

cues.en: So let's load up our sample data.
cues.zh: 載入範例資料。

cues.en: I'm going to use the Pandas library that's part of our scientific python environment here to actually load up these CSV files.
cues.zh: 用科學運算 Python 環境中的 pandas 函式庫，載入這些 CSV 檔。

cues.en: They're just comma separated value data files.
cues.zh: 就是逗號分隔值資料檔。

cues.en: We'll massage that data, clean it up a little bit, and get it into a form that Keras can accept.
cues.zh: 稍微整理、清理資料，轉成 Keras 能接受的格式。

cues.en: If you're new to Pandas and want a primer on it, you'll find a PandasTutorial.ipynb file in the course materials as well.
cues.zh: 如果不熟悉 pandas，想要入門，教材也有 PandasTutorial.ipynb。

cues.en: It'll walk you through the basics.
cues.zh: 會帶你了解基礎。

cues.en: If you'd like, you can pause now and go through that first.
cues.zh: 如果想，現在可先暫停，先看那個。

cues.en: Let's start by importing the Pandas library; we'll call it PD for short.
cues.zh: 先匯入 pandas 函式庫，簡寫為 pd。

cues.en: We need to tell our notebook where the data is stored, so you need to change this next line to indicate where exactly the DeepLearningIntro folder of the course materials is stored on your system.
cues.zh: 要告訴 Notebook 資料在哪裡，因此修改下一行，指出系統中課程教材 DeepLearningIntro 資料夾的確切位置。

cues.en: Change this to indicate the file path to your own course materials, which is definitely different from mine.
cues.zh: 改成你自己的教材路徑，肯定與我的不同。

cues.en: I've built up this array of column names because it's not included as a header in this CSV file, so I need to provide that by hand.
cues.zh: 因為 CSV 沒有包含標題列，我手動建立欄名陣列。

cues.en: The columns of the input data are going to be the political party, Republican or Democrat, and then a list of different votes that they voted on.
cues.zh: 輸入資料的欄，先是政黨，共和黨或民主黨，再來是各項議題的投票。

cues.en: So for example we can see whether each politician voted yay or nay on religious groups in schools.
cues.zh: 例如，可以看到每位政治人物，對學校中的宗教團體，是投贊成還是反對。

cues.en: I'm not really sure what the details of that particular bill were, but by reading these you can probably guess the direction that the different parties would've probably voted toward.
cues.zh: 我不確定那個法案的細節，但讀這些項目，大概就能猜到各政黨可能的投票方向。

cues.en: So we'll go ahead and read that CSV file using Panda's read_csv function.
cues.zh: 用 pandas 的 read_csv 讀取 CSV。

cues.en: We will say that any missing values will be populated with a question mark and we'll pass in a names array of the feature names so we'll know what to call the columns.
cues.zh: 指定問號代表缺失值，並傳入包含特徵名稱的 names 陣列，讓我們知道各欄名稱。

cues.en: And we'll just display the resulting data frame using the head command.
cues.zh: 再用 head，顯示結果 DataFrame。

cues.en: Go ahead and hit shift + enter to set that up and you should see the first five entries of our dataframe.
cues.zh: 按 Shift+Enter 設定，應該看到 DataFrame 前五筆資料。

cues.en: Now we can also use the describe function on the resulting dataframe to get a high level overview of the nature of the data.
cues.zh: 也可以對結果 DataFrame 用 describe，概覽資料性質。

cues.en: For example, you can see there's a lot of missing data.
cues.zh: 例如，可看到很多缺失資料。

cues.en: Even though there are 435 people that have a party associated with them, only 387 of them actually had a vote on the water project cost sharing bill, for example.
cues.zh: 雖然 435 人都有政黨，但例如水利工程費用分攤法案，實際只有 387 人有投票。

cues.en: So we have to deal with missing data here somehow and the easiest thing to do is just throw away rows that have missing data.
cues.zh: 所以，得處理缺失資料，最簡單是直接丟掉有缺失資料的列。

cues.en: In the real world you'd want to make sure that you're not introducing some sort of unintentional bias by doing that.
cues.zh: 真實世界中，要確定不會因此引入無意的偏差。

cues.en: Perhaps there's more of a tendency for Republicans to not vote than Democrats, or vice versa.
cues.zh: 也許共和黨比民主黨更傾向不投票，或反過來。

cues.en: If that were the case you might be biasing your analysis by throwing out politicians that didn't vote on every actual issue here.
cues.zh: 如果是那樣，丟掉沒有對每項議題投票的政治人物，可能讓分析偏斜。

cues.en: But let's assume that there is no such bias and we can just go ahead and drop those missing values.
cues.zh: 但先假設沒有這種偏差，直接刪除缺失值。

cues.en: That's what this little line here does: dropna(inplace=True).
cues.zh: 這行就是在做這件事：dropna(inplace=True)。

cues.en: That just means we're going to drop any rows that are missing data from our voting data frame.
cues.zh: 表示從投票 DataFrame 中，移除任何缺少資料的列。

cues.en: We'll describe it again and we should see that every column has the same count because there is no missing data at this point.
cues.zh: 再次 describe，應該看到每欄筆數相同，因為此時已無缺失資料。

cues.en: So we've winnowed things down to 232 politicians here.
cues.zh: 因此，縮減為 232 位政治人物。

cues.en: Not ideal but hey, that's what we have to work with.
cues.zh: 不理想，但這就是能用的資料。

cues.en: The next thing we need to do is actually massage the data into a form that Keras can consume.
cues.zh: 接著，把資料整理成 Keras 能使用的格式。

cues.en: So Keras does not deal with Y's and N's, it deals with numbers.
cues.zh: Keras 不處理 y 與 n，而是數字。

cues.en: So let's replace all the Y's and N's with ones and zeroes, using the replace function.
cues.zh: 用 replace，把所有 y、n 換成一與零。

cues.en: And similarly we'll replace the strings Democrat and Republican also with the numbers one and zero.
cues.zh: 同樣，把 Democrat 與 Republican 字串，也換成一與零。

cues.en: So this is turning this into a binary classification problem.
cues.zh: 這就轉成二元分類問題。

cues.en: If we classify someone as belonging to label one that will indicate they're a Democrat.
cues.zh: 如果分類為標籤一，表示民主黨。

cues.en: And label zero will indicate that they're a Republican.
cues.zh: 標籤零，表示共和黨。

cues.en: So let's go ahead and run that to clean up the data.
cues.zh: 執行，清理資料。

cues.en: And we should see now
cues.zh: 現在應該看到，

cues.en: if we run head on that data frame again, everything has been converted to numerical data between zero and one which is exactly what we want for the input to a neural network.
cues.zh: 再對 DataFrame 用 head，全部已轉成零與一的數值資料，正是神經網路輸入需要的。

cues.en: All right finally let's extract this data into a numpy array we can actually feed to Keras.
cues.zh: 最後，取成真正能送入 Keras 的 NumPy 陣列。

cues.en: So to do that we're just going call "values" on the columns we care about.
cues.zh: 只要對在意的欄，呼叫 values。

cues.en: We're going to extract all of the feature columns into the all_features array.
cues.zh: 把所有特徵欄，擷取到 all_features 陣列。

cues.en: And all of the actual labels, the actual parties, into an all_classes array.
cues.zh: 把實際標籤，也就是政黨，放進 all_classes 陣列。

cues.en: So let's go ahead and hit shift + enter to get that in.
cues.zh: 按 Shift+Enter 執行。

cues.en: And at this point I'm going to turn it over to you for now.
cues.zh: 現在，暫時交給你。

cues.en: The code snippets you need for binary classification were actually covered in the slides just prior to coming out to this notebook here.
cues.zh: 二元分類所需的程式片段，就在進入這個 Notebook 前的投影片裡。

cues.en: So just refer back to that and that should give you the stuff you need to work off of.
cues.zh: 回去參考，就能取得所需起點。

cues.en: I want you to try it yourself.
cues.zh: 我要你自己試試。

cues.en: My answer is below but no peeking just yet.
cues.zh: 我的答案在下方，但先別偷看。

cues.en: Hit pause and come back later and you can compare your results to mine.
cues.zh: 暫停，之後回來，與我的結果比較。

cues.en: All right I hope you did your homework here.
cues.zh: 好，希望你做了作業。

cues.en: Let's go ahead and take a look at my implementation.
cues.zh: 看看我的實作。

cues.en: Again it's pretty much taken from the slides that I showed you earlier for binary classification.
cues.zh: 同樣，大致取自先前展示的二元分類投影片。

cues.en: All we're going to do is import the stuff we need from Keras here.
cues.zh: 只要從 Keras 匯入需要的東西。

cues.en: We're using dense, dropout, and sequential, and we're also going to use cross_val_score to actually evaluate our model and illustrate integrating Keras with scikit-learn.
cues.zh: 使用 Dense、Dropout 與 Sequential，也使用 cross_val_score 評估模型，示範 Keras 與 scikit-learn 整合。

cues.en: When we're integrating with scikit learn we need to create a function that creates our model so we can pass that into cross_val_score.
cues.zh: 整合 scikit-learn 時，需要建立一個產生模型的函數，才能傳給 cross_val_score。

cues.en: We're going to create a Sequential model, and follow the pattern that we showed earlier of doing a binary classification problem.
cues.zh: 建立 Sequential 模型，依照前面二元分類問題的模式。

cues.en: So in this case we have 16 different issues that people voted on.
cues.zh: 這裡有 16 個不同的投票議題。

cues.en: We're going to use a Relu activation function with a layer of 32 neurons.
cues.zh: 使用 ReLU 激活函數，這層 32 個神經元。

cues.en: A pretty common pattern is to start with a large number of neurons in one layer, and winnow things down as you get to higher layers.
cues.zh: 常見模式，是某層先有較多神經元，往更高層逐漸縮小。

cues.en: So we'll distill those 32 neurons down to another layer of 16 neurons.
cues.zh: 因此，把 32 個神經元，濃縮到另一層 16 個神經元。

cues.en: I'm using the term units in this particular example here.
cues.zh: 這個例子使用 units 這個詞。

cues.en: As an aside more and more researchers are using the term units instead of neuron.
cues.zh: 順帶一提，越來越多研究者，用「單元」取代「神經元」。

cues.en: You're seeing that in some of the APIs and libraries that are coming out recently.
cues.zh: 最近的部分 API 與函式庫，都會看到。

cues.en: The reason is that we're starting to diverge a little bit between artificial neural networks and how they work, and how the human brain actually works.
cues.zh: 原因是，人工神經網路的運作，與真正人腦，已開始有些不同。

cues.en: In some cases we're actually improving on biology.
cues.zh: 某些情況，甚至改善了生物機制。

cues.en: So some researchers are taking issue with calling these artificial neurons because we've moved beyond neurons, and our artificial neurons are becoming their own thing at this point.
cues.zh: 所以，有些研究者反對再叫人工神經元，因為已經超越神經元，人工神經元已發展成自己的東西。

cues.en: Finally we'll have one last layer with a single output neuron for our binary classification, with a sigmoid activation function to choose between zero and one.
cues.zh: 最後一層，單一輸出神經元，做二元分類，以 Sigmoid 激活函數，在零與一之間選擇。

cues.en: And we'll use the binary cross-entropy function, the Adam optimizer, and kick it off.
cues.zh: 使用 binary_crossentropy 函數、Adam 最佳化器，開始執行。

cues.en: At that point we can set up a Keras classifier to actually execute that.
cues.zh: 接著，設定 KerasClassifier，真正執行。

cues.en: And we will create an estimator object from that, which we can then pass into scikit-learn's cross_val_score to actually perform K-fold cross-validation automatically.
cues.zh: 從它建立估計器物件，再傳給 scikit-learn 的 cross_val_score，自動做 k 折交叉驗證。

cues.en: Finally, we will display the mean result when we're done.
cues.zh: 最後，顯示平均結果。

cues.en: So shift + enter and we'll see how long this takes.
cues.zh: 按 Shift+Enter，看看需要多久。

cues.en: Mind you in 1984, politicians were not as polarized as they are today so it might be a little harder than it would be today to actually predict someone's parties just based on their votes.
cues.zh: 注意，1984 年政治人物不像今天那麼兩極化，所以光根據投票預測政黨，可能比今天難。

cues.en: It would be very interesting to see if that's the case using more modern data.
cues.zh: 如果用較現代資料驗證，會很有意思。

cues.en: After a few minutes it's done: 93% accuracy, and that's without even trying too hard.
cues.zh: 幾分鐘後完成：93% 準確率，甚至沒花太多工夫。

cues.en: We didn't really spend any time tuning the topology of this network at all so maybe you can do a better job.
cues.zh: 根本沒花時間調整網路拓樸，因此也許你能做得更好。

cues.en: If you did get a significantly better result, post that in the course here.
cues.zh: 如果結果明顯更好，請貼到課程裡。

cues.en: I'm sure other students would like to hear about what you did.
cues.zh: 其他同學應該也想知道，你做了什麼。

cues.en: So there you have it.
cues.zh: 就是這樣。

cues.en: Using Keras for a more interesting example with real-world data.
cues.zh: 用真實資料，做更有趣的 Keras 範例。

cues.en: We predicted people's political parties using a neural network, and integrated it with scikit-learn to make life even easier.
cues.zh: 我們用神經網路預測政黨，並整合 scikit-learn，讓事情更容易。

cues.en: That's the magic of Keras for you!
cues.zh: 這就是 Keras 的魔法。
